## Learning Objectives

1.	**Summarize demographic survey data** using engaging visuals;
2.	**Iterate** to improve visualizations and apply best practices;
3.	**Identify alternatives** for displaying part-to-whole relationships;

This tutorial supports The Ohio State University Libraries Research Commons [Tableau and Surveys](https://library.osu.edu/events?combine=&tid=All&field_location_code_value=10&sort_bef_combine=field_end_date_value_ASC) workshop series. Building on concepts introduced in the [Tableau for Research](./tableau_for_research.ipynb) workshops, it introduces **INTERMEDIATE** Tableau users to techniques for working with, analyzing, and communicating survey data in Tableau.
